solutions.title: Copy values and compare ends
solutions.strategy: Copy every node value into an array, then compare symmetric positions from the outside inward.

timeComplexity.explanation: The algorithm scans the list once and then compares each array position at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The copied value array stores every node value.

solutions.title: Reverse the second half in place
solutions.strategy: Find the midpoint, reverse the second half, compare it against the first half, then reverse that half again to restore the original list shape.

timeComplexity.explanation: Finding the midpoint, reversing half the list, comparing halves, and restoring the half are all linear in total.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The algorithm stores only traversal and reversal pointers while reusing list nodes.
